architectureDecision: Generate complete static HTML from canonical Git data and reusable templates, preserve runtime-sensitive DOM through cutover, and use targeted client enhancement for existing wallet/transaction behavior plus owned Navbar, Tabs, and first-paint modules.

tickets.title: Capture and freeze the published baseline
tickets.objective: Own reproducible published HTTP, DOM, CSS/runtime, screenshot, route, and Collection Utility evidence before implementation.
scope: Capture four static routes, CMS item-route behavior, unknown-path behavior, external request inventory, exact CSS/runtime hashes, and four responsive families
Record content freeze and sanitized fixture policy
Resolve Collection Utility published structure sufficiently for reconstruction
nonGoals: No asset/font download unless separately authorized
validation: All eight route families intentionally sampled or enumerated
Collection Utility gap explicitly resolved or blocked
tickets.rollback: Local evidence only; remove/recreate fixtures while Webflow remains unchanged.
tickets.completionGate: Published comparator, content freeze, route/status behavior, and Collection Utility recovery evidence are reviewable and hash-addressed.

tickets.title: Acquire and verify Webflow-hosted assets
tickets.objective: Create independent verified ownership for 13 material non-CMS assets and 66 CMS media records.
scope: Acquire exact authorized bytes and responsive variants
Define stable main-token-ID naming and hashed deployment mapping
Cover logo, hero, Collection Utility banner, spinner/state art, arrows, coin, favicon/webclip, and token media
nonGoals: No image redesign or format conversion
validation: Decoded visual comparison where bytes differ
tickets.rollback: Keep production Webflow URLs active; imported assets are additive and unused.
tickets.completionGate: Every required current media dependency has verified local bytes or an explicit blocking exception.

tickets.title: Verify and implement independent font delivery
tickets.objective: Remove Google WebFont Loader/Google-host dependency while preserving Changa One and Inconsolata metrics and fallback behavior.
scope: Verify licenses/provenance and exact binaries for Changa One 400 normal/italic and Inconsolata 400/700
Define local font-face, preload, font-display, and fallback stacks
tickets.rollback: Retain current font loading until the local path passes; revert the isolated font CSS/assets.
tickets.completionGate: An authorized, independently deliverable font set or an explicitly approved metric-equivalent path is proven.

tickets.title: Create canonical CMS replacement data
tickets.objective: Import four collections and 66 items into validated Git-owned structured data.
scope: Import exact titles, IDs, Editions, Mint Dates, slugs, labels, image paths/alts, and explicit orders
Derive Name, acidValue, OBJKT URL, and environment identity
Retain Webflow metadata only as migration provenance
validation: 35 Mint Dates and INTRO explicit order
tickets.rollback: Additive data layer not yet consumed by production; revert data/validator patch.
tickets.completionGate: The full presentation dataset validates without a Webflow read and unresolved semantics remain labeled.

tickets.title: Resolve HEN sparse-token thumbnail mapping
tickets.objective: Make HEN media lookup correct for sparse mainnet IDs and active Shadownet mirror IDs without implicit 0-16 mainnet keys.
scope: Define mainTokenId as canonical asset key
Implement or generate explicit adapter from shared mirror mapping
Cover 17 sparse IDs and 17 active IDs
likelyFiles: admin-ui/src/thumbs.manifest.js only if a later scoped consumer decision explicitly requires it
validation: Public and admin consumer impact reviewed
tickets.rollback: Revert adapter/manifest while existing Webflow image URLs remain available.
tickets.completionGate: Every HEN identity resolves the intended verified asset in both identity contexts.

tickets.title: Localize the Webflow CSS baseline
tickets.objective: Serve the complete current presentation baseline locally with owned load order and no Webflow stylesheet request.
scope: Vendor exact frozen CSS with provenance
Localize asset/font URLs via reviewed override or manifest
Preserve reset/base, widgets, states, forms, first-paint rules, and four breakpoints
Inventory inline page CSS and establish load order
tickets.rollback: Continue serving current remote CSS in production until the isolated local baseline passes.
tickets.completionGate: All current presentation dependencies are locally addressable without combining migration and restyling.

tickets.title: Reconstruct Collection Utility locally
tickets.objective: Create the missing Git-owned Collection Utility source from frozen published evidence.
scope: Reconstruct exact shared shell and page-specific structure
Integrate verified banner/logo/spinner/fonts and local CSS
Preserve metadata, links, wallet/first-paint selectors, responsive serialization, and route
Determine whether any feature-specific runtime exists
nonGoals: No shared-shell refactor beyond evidenced parity
tickets.rollback: Collection Utility remains served by Webflow; local reconstruction is isolated until generation/cutover.
tickets.completionGate: The formerly missing route has a source-owned, evidence-matched local representation with no hidden unresolved runtime.

tickets.title: Implement deterministic page and route generation
tickets.objective: Build the shared shell, four static routes, 66 compatibility routes, route manifest, and deterministic deploy tree.
scope: Render Home, Collection Utility, Drops, Exchange shell/body slots
Render captured CMS template status/body behavior for exact slugs
Emit directory-index routes, 404, manifests, and generated-file policy
nonGoals: No CMS row behavior yet beyond slots
validation: Eight route families and 66 exact item paths
tickets.rollback: Existing checked snapshots and Webflow remain deployable; generated artifact is not promoted.
tickets.completionGate: A clean checkout deterministically emits the complete route tree from source templates/data.

tickets.title: Generate CMS rows with DOM-contract parity
tickets.objective: Generate the five Drops/Exchange collection lists from canonical data while preserving every runtime-sensitive contract.
scope: Implement checkbox and quantity row templates with list/page variants
Generate HEN, INTRODUCTIONS, and CANAAN Drops lists plus SCRIPT/CANAAN Exchange lists
Preserve hidden IDs, ancestry, cloneability, stamping levels, pane/list membership, image/title/edition descendants, and explicit order
validation: 97 audited row occurrences and list counts
tickets.rollback: Revert generated-row templates and use the previous static artifact/Webflow baseline.
tickets.completionGate: Existing Git consumers pass against generated rows without selector or transaction identity changes.

tickets.title: Replace the Webflow Navbar runtime
tickets.objective: Provide owned responsive, pointer, keyboard, focus, ARIA, overlay, current-route, wallet-compatible, and no-JS navigation.
scope: Standalone Navbar module and state CSS
Owned hamburger glyph replacing webflow-icons dependency
tickets.rollback: Restore the prior artifact/Webflow Navbar runtime before promotion.
tickets.completionGate: All four static pages navigate accessibly without Webflow JS or webflow-icons.

tickets.title: Replace Exchange Tabs and the 500 ms seam
tickets.objective: Own accessible tab behavior and make pane/contract identity synchronously ready before Exchange consumes it.
scope: Coordinate exchange initializer to remove fixed 500 ms
tickets.rollback: Revert Tabs and Exchange integration together; serve the prior immutable artifact/Webflow.
tickets.completionGate: Exchange never infers contract identity before an explicit valid selected pane and no fixed-delay correctness dependency remains.

tickets.title: Harden first paint with visible-first enhancement
tickets.objective: Remove the permanent-hide failure mode while preserving stable first render and page-specific readiness behavior.
tickets.rollback: Revert first-paint module/styles together and redeploy prior artifact; Webflow remains fallback.
tickets.completionGate: No supported failure mode can leave the only useful page content permanently hidden.

tickets.title: Build the reproducible static deployment pipeline
tickets.objective: Build, validate, identify, deploy, verify, retain, and roll back one complete same-origin static artifact.
likelyFiles: package-lock.json only for explicitly required pinned tooling
nonGoals: No vendor switch without failed capability evidence
tickets.rollback: Redeploy the retained prior artifact; production remains Webflow until cutover ticket.
tickets.completionGate: The validated bytes can be promoted without rebuilding and rolled back to a retained artifact.

tickets.title: Enforce automated data, route, dependency, and DOM contracts
tickets.objective: Turn canonical data, route completeness, dependency independence, and hard DOM/CSS contracts into required automated gates.
scope: Forbidden Webflow URL/runtime and external inventory
Five list contracts and selector ancestry
tickets.rollback: Revert isolated validators only if demonstrably incorrect; never waive a valid contract failure for cutover.
tickets.completionGate: CI fails on every known data/route/Webflow-dependency/DOM contract violation.

tickets.title: Validate browser behavior, accessibility, wallet, and transactions
tickets.objective: Prove functional parity across widgets, runtime rows, wallet/network states, and safe transaction scope.
scope: Transaction preconditions and approved Shadownet smoke
nonGoals: No feature fix hidden inside validation
tickets.rollback: Staging-only; revert the owning implementation ticket/artifact and rerun the entire affected matrix.
tickets.completionGate: Every hard runtime contract and authorized transaction-safety check has passing evidence.

tickets.title: Establish visual and responsive regression gates
tickets.objective: Prove owned presentation parity for all pages, material states, responsive families, and font/image/first-paint conditions.
scope: Drops and Exchange material wallet/cart/modal/tab/list states
tickets.rollback: Keep artifact in staging and revert the owning asset/CSS/widget/page change.
tickets.completionGate: Visual parity is evidenced for all required scenarios under the approved difference policy.

tickets.title: Close route and Webflow-independence validation
tickets.objective: Reconcile all cutover criteria and prove the candidate artifact performs no required Webflow request.
tickets.rollback: No mutation; failed criteria return work to the owning ticket.
tickets.completionGate: No unresolved BLOCKING BEFORE CUTOVER risk and the candidate artifact is independently reproducible.

tickets.title: Execute and rehearse the staging cutover
tickets.objective: Dual-run the exact candidate at a production-like staging origin and prove deployment, monitoring, and rollback operations.
tickets.rollback: Redeploy prior staging artifact; production Webflow remains unchanged.
tickets.completionGate: The exact production candidate and rehearsed rollback procedure pass staging; production still requires explicit approval.

tickets.title: Execute the approved production cutover
tickets.objective: Switch production to the validated artifact with immediate tested rollback and transaction/network monitoring.
nonGoals: No Webflow deletion/unpublish unless a rollback procedure explicitly requires authorized publication
tickets.rollback: Restore prior DNS/deploy target or redeploy retained known-good artifact using the rehearsed procedure.
tickets.completionGate: Production serves the validated Git artifact stably inside the monitoring window; Webflow remains retained.

tickets.title: Close rollback window and decommission Webflow
tickets.objective: Verify all Webflow-removal criteria, retain required evidence, and decommission only after explicit approval.
scope: Authorized domain detachment/unpublish as reversible steps
Archive published baseline and rollback artifact
nonGoals: No removal while a REQUIRED criterion is open
tickets.rollback: Before final detachment, restore frozen Webflow; after detachment, use the retained proven artifact/site restoration path. Destructive deletion is excluded.
tickets.completionGate: Webflow has no operational role, retention requirements are met, and decommission is explicitly approved.

tickets.title: Perform post-migration presentation and legacy cleanup
tickets.objective: Reduce migration scaffolding only after the production rollback window without changing evidenced behavior.
scope: Independently ticket selected cleanup such as CSS extraction, dead `.w-*` removal, runtime entrypoint rename, jQuery removal, unique control IDs, or asset optimization
Maintain contract and screenshot gates per cleanup
nonGoals: No route/content change without a separate decision
validation: One cleanup concern per child ticket
tickets.rollback: Revert each small cleanup independently to the decommissioned production baseline.
tickets.completionGate: Optional; each selected cleanup is separately reviewed and behavior-preserving.
